contentList.content: You gain a +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="SpellDifficultyClass">Spell Save DC</LSTag> and a +[2] bonus to spell <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.

When you deal damage with this rapier in combat, you create Hellfire with a radius of [1] for [2] turns. Hellfire does not affect you.

You ignore your targets' Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage.
Lunge forward and unleash a wave of hellfire from your weapon.
